  <div class="topbar"><div class="wrap topbar-inner"><span><strong>DIGITAL INDIA</strong> &nbsp; Har digital kaam, ek hi jagah</span><span class="top-contact">⌖ Road SH-88, Antaur, Darbhanga &nbsp; · &nbsp; ☎ 9306859320</span></div></div>
  <header>
    <div class="wrap nav">
      <a class="brand" href="#home" aria-label="DIGISEVA 360 home"><img class="brand-logo" src="data:image/png;base64," alt="DIGISEVA 360 — CSC & Multi Services Center, Directed by Raju Sharma"></a>
      <nav class="nav-links" id="navLinks" aria-label="Main navigation"><a href="#services">Services</a><a href="#documents">Documents</a><a href="#about">About</a><a href="#contact">Contact</a></nav>
      <div class="nav-actions"><a class="btn btn-outline" href="#documents">Document checklist</a><a class="btn btn-green" href="https://wa.me/919306859320?text=Hello%20Raju%20Sharma%20ji%2C%20I%20want%20information%20about%20DIGISEVA%20360." target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">WhatsApp ↗</a><button class="menu-toggle" id="menuToggle" aria-label="Toggle navigation" aria-expanded="false">☰</button></div>

  <main id="home">
    <section class="hero"><div class="wrap hero-grid">
      <div><div class="eyebrow"><i>✦</i> YOUR LOCAL DIGITAL SERVICES CENTER</div>
        <h1>Your trusted <span>digital partner</span> in Darbhanga.</h1>
        <p class="hero-copy">Digital assistance for banking, PAN and ID services, Bihar land records, online applications, printing, travel bookings and more — all in one convenient place.</p>
        <div class="search-wrap"><span class="search-icon">⌕</span><input id="serviceSearch" type="search" placeholder="Search a service — PAN, Aadhaar, land records..." aria-label="Search services"><button class="clear-search" id="clearSearch" type="button">Clear</button></div>
        <div class="quick-search"><b>Popular:</b><button type="button" data-search="PAN">PAN Card</button><button type="button" data-search="Aadhaar">Aadhaar</button><button type="button" data-search="land">Land records</button><button type="button" data-search="cash">Cash withdrawal</button></div>
        <div class="hero-actions"><a class="btn btn-cyan" href="tel:9306859320">☎ Call Raju: 9306859320</a><button class="btn btn-outline" type="button" data-open-checklist>View required documents</button></div>
      </div>
      <aside class="hero-card"><div class="hero-card-head"><div><h2>DIGISEVA 360 HUB</h2><p>CSC & Multi Services Center</p></div><span class="status-dot" aria-label="Service center"></span></div>
        <div class="info-row"><span>Proprietor</span><strong>RAJU SHARMA</strong></div><div class="info-row"><span>Location</span><strong>Antaur, Alinagar</strong></div><div class="info-row"><span>Landmark</span><strong>Road SH-88, Darbhanga</strong></div><div class="info-row"><span>Services</span><strong>Digital & online assistance</strong></div>
        <button class="btn btn-cyan" type="button" data-book="General service inquiry">Send a service inquiry ↗</button>
      </aside>
    </div></section>
    <section class="section" id="services"><div class="wrap"><div class="section-head"><div class="kicker">Explore our offerings</div><h2>Digital services, made simpler.</h2><p>Choose a service to ask about requirements, process and availability.</p></div>
      <div class="services-grid" id="servicesGrid">
        <article class="service-card" data-title="banking cash withdrawal money transfer balance enquiry mini statement aeps micro atm"><div class="service-icon">▣</div><div class="service-tag">AePS & Micro ATM</div><h3>Banking Services</h3><ul><li>Cash withdrawal (fingerprint)</li><li>Domestic money transfer (DMT)</li><li>Balance enquiry & mini statement</li></ul><div class="card-actions"><button class="btn btn-outline" data-book="Banking & Cash AePS Services">Ask about service</button><a class="portal-link" href="https://myaadhaar.uidai.gov.in/" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">UIDAI portal ↗</a></div></article>
        <article class="service-card" data-title="government certificates caste income domicile sarkari yojana aadhaar seva ration card edistrict bihar rtps"><div class="service-icon">▤</div><div class="service-tag">Certificates & schemes</div><h3>Government Services</h3><ul><li>Caste, income & residence certificates</li><li>Government scheme applications</li><li>Ration card & eDistrict assistance</li></ul><div class="card-actions"><button class="btn btn-outline" data-book="Government Certificates & Schemes">Ask about service</button><a class="portal-link" href="https://serviceonline.bihar.gov.in/" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">RTPS Bihar portal ↗</a></div></article>
        <article class="service-card" data-title="online forms government jobs admissions scholarships exam forms admit card sarkari result"><div class="service-icon">▣</div><div class="service-tag">Jobs & exams</div><h3>Online Forms</h3><ul><li>Government job applications</li><li>Admissions & scholarship forms</li><li>Exam forms & admit card printing</li></ul><div class="card-actions"><button class="btn btn-outline" data-book="Online Job / Admission Form">Ask about service</button><a class="portal-link" href="https://www.sarkariresult.com/" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">Sarkari Result ↗</a></div></article>

  <div class="modal-backdrop" id="bookingModal" role="dialog" aria-modal="true" aria-labelledby="bookingTitle"><div class="modal"><div class="modal-head"><h2 id="bookingTitle">Service inquiry</h2><button class="close-modal" type="button" data-close-modal aria-label="Close">✕</button></div><p id="bookingDescription">Tell us what service you need. Your message will open in WhatsApp.</p><form id="bookingForm"><label for="customerName">Your name</label><input id="customerName" name="name" autocomplete="name" placeholder="Enter your name" required><label for="customerService">Service</label><input id="customerService" name="service" readonly><label for="customerMessage">Message (optional)</label><input id="customerMessage" name="message" placeholder="Any details or questions"><button class="btn btn-green" type="submit">Continue to WhatsApp ↗</button></form></div></div>
  <div class="modal-backdrop" id="checklistModal" role="dialog" aria-modal="true" aria-labelledby="checklistTitle"><div class="modal"><div class="modal-head"><h2 id="checklistTitle">Quick document checklist</h2><button class="close-modal" type="button" data-close-modal aria-label="Close">✕</button></div><p>Bring the documents relevant to your service. Requirements differ by application.</p><ul class="checklist"><li>Aadhaar / accepted identity proof</li><li>Active mobile number</li><li>Relevant address or land documents</li><li>Photograph, if required</li><li>Application-specific supporting documents</li></ul><p>Call 9306859320 to confirm the exact list before visiting.</p><button class="btn btn-cyan" type="button" data-close-modal>Got it</button></div></div>
  <script>
    (() => {
      const search = document.getElementById('serviceSearch');
      const cards = [...document.querySelectorAll('.service-card')];
      const noResults = document.getElementById('noResults');
      const bookingModal = document.getElementById('bookingModal');
      const checklistModal = document.getElementById('checklistModal');
      const serviceInput = document.getElementById('customerService');
      const menuToggle = document.getElementById('menuToggle');
      const navLinks = document.getElementById('navLinks');

      // Remember this browser so visitors see a different greeting on return visits.
      const welcomeToast = document.getElementById('welcomeToast');
      const welcomeTitle = document.getElementById('welcomeTitle');
      const welcomeMessage = document.getElementById('welcomeMessage');
      let returningVisitor = false;
      try {
        returningVisitor = localStorage.getItem('digiseva360_visited') === 'yes';
        localStorage.setItem('digiseva360_visited', 'yes');
      } catch (error) {
        // If browser storage is blocked, show the first-visit greeting.
      }
      welcomeTitle.textContent = returningVisitor ? 'Welcome back to DIGISEVA 360' : 'Welcome to DIGISEVA 360';
      welcomeMessage.textContent = returningVisitor
        ? 'Thank you for visiting us again. How may we assist you today?'
        : 'Your trusted destination for digital and citizen services. How may we assist you today?';
      requestAnimationFrame(() => welcomeToast.classList.add('show'));
      const hideWelcome = () => welcomeToast.classList.remove('show');
      document.getElementById('welcomeClose').addEventListener('click', hideWelcome);
      window.setTimeout(hideWelcome, 4800);

      function filterServices(value) {
        const query = value.trim().toLowerCase();
        let visible = 0;
        cards.forEach(card => {
          const match = !query || (card.dataset.title + ' ' + card.textContent).toLowerCase().includes(query);
          card.classList.toggle('hidden', !match);
          if (match) visible++;
        });
        noResults.style.display = visible ? 'none' : 'block';
      }
      search.addEventListener('input', () => filterServices(search.value));
      document.getElementById('clearSearch').addEventListener('click', () => {
        search.value = ''; filterServices(''); search.focus();
      });
      document.querySelectorAll('[data-search]').forEach(button => button.addEventListener('click', () => {
        search.value = button.dataset.search; filterServices(search.value);
        document.getElementById('services').scrollIntoView({behavior:'smooth'});
      }));
      function openModal(modal) { modal.classList.add('open'); document.body.style.overflow='hidden'; }
      function closeModals() {
        document.querySelectorAll('.modal-backdrop').forEach(modal => modal.classList.remove('open'));
        document.body.style.overflow='';
      }
      document.querySelectorAll('[data-book]').forEach(button => button.addEventListener('click', () => {
        serviceInput.value = button.dataset.book; openModal(bookingModal);
      }));
      document.querySelectorAll('[data-open-checklist]').forEach(button => button.addEventListener('click', () => openModal(checklistModal)));
      document.querySelectorAll('[data-close-modal]').forEach(button => button.addEventListener('click', closeModals));
      document.querySelectorAll('.modal-backdrop').forEach(backdrop => backdrop.addEventListener('click', event => {
        if (event.target === backdrop) closeModals();
      }));
      document.addEventListener('keydown', event => { if (event.key === 'Escape') closeModals(); });
      document.getElementById('bookingForm').addEventListener('submit', event => {
        event.preventDefault();
        const name = document.getElementById('customerName').value.trim();
        const service = serviceInput.value;
        const message = document.getElementById('customerMessage').value.trim();
        const text = `Hello Raju Sharma ji, my name is ${name}. I want information about: ${service}.${message ? ' Details: ' + message : ''}`;
        window.open('https://wa.me/919306859320?text=' + encodeURIComponent(text), '_blank', 'noopener,noreferrer');
        closeModals();
      });
      menuToggle.addEventListener('click', () => {
        const expanded = menuToggle.getAttribute('aria-expanded') === 'true';
        menuToggle.setAttribute('aria-expanded', String(!expanded));
        navLinks.classList.toggle('open', !expanded);
      });
      navLinks.querySelectorAll('a').forEach(link => link.addEventListener('click', () => {
        navLinks.classList.remove('open'); menuToggle.setAttribute('aria-expanded','false');
      }));
      document.getElementById('year').textContent = new Date().getFullYear();
    })();
  </script>
</body>
